entries.0256c90f8c3ccec5: The business consists of a plant division that designs, manufactures and constructs equipment such as industrial furnaces, and an engineering division that applies refractories inside industrial furnaces. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥6,430 million.
entries.0d799291e02f7325: The business designs, manufactures, constructs and sells industrial furnaces that fire target materials using gas, heavy oil, electricity or other heat sources, and automation equipment for manufacturing lines. The equipment is used in a variety of fields, including the ceramics and chemical industries. Iwasa Kikai Kogyo Co., Ltd. (consolidated subsidiary), which designs, manufactures, constructs and sells rotary kilns, is also included in this division. Revenue by division is not disclosed separately.
entries.0fc1128f0575f5a9: This category is not included in the reportable segments and sells outsourced products and other items. The products are used in a variety of fields, including cement, lime and the environmental sector. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥71 million.
entries.1d6cde20e11409d0: Sales and maintenance of cement manufacturing equipment
entries.21f7d6c0a3979934: A ceramics manufacturer that makes refractories such as refractory bricks and ceramic products, and also handles the design and construction of industrial furnace plants.
entries.316b8388119e888e: The business is conducted by the consolidated subsidiary Bishu Kohsan Co., Ltd., which sells and constructs building materials and paving materials. It handles indoor floor coatings for factories, buildings and public structures, and outdoor paving materials for promenades, parking lots and bicycle paths; the company manufactures and supplies some of the paving materials and processed products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,263 million.
entries.5f36bf6696acd1f6: The business manufactures and sells refractory materials, such as refractory bricks and unshaped refractories, and ceramic products. The products are used in industries such as the cement industry, and are used for the construction, repair and maintenance of furnaces and kilns that require durability and fire resistance at high temperatures. The company offers high quality and durable products and also responds to customization and support according to customer-specified requirements. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥6,992 million, making this the largest business in the group.

entries.7e7f347f1ccd54c6: The business leases part of the properties it owns for offices and residences. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥395 million.
entries.d13a0bbc195ec43e: For plant equipment in materials industries such as cement manufacturing, lime manufacturing, and environmental and resource recycling, the division provides integrated services from design and construction to proposal-based technical services, using refractories manufactured in-house. The company also serves as a Japanese sales agent for Fuller Technologies, a U.S. cement equipment manufacturer, and sells and maintains that company's manufacturing equipment. Revenue by division is not disclosed separately.
